exercises.title: Exercise 1 — fix the SQL injection in a product search
exercises.problemHtml:
The search procedure in solution.sql glues the user's text into SQL code. Try it: EXEC dbo.prTimSanPham N'x%'' UNION SELECT id, ten, 1 FROM dbo.SanPham --' shows every product at price 1. Rewrite dbo.prTimSanPham @tuKhoa so that the keyword is only ever a value: normal searches work, the payload returns nothing and raises no error, and '; DROP TABLE … does nothing.

Runs on YOUR SQL Server, not in the browser. The vulnerable code is T-SQL dynamic SQL (EXEC of a concatenated string) inside a procedure; the attack and the fix only make sense on a real SQL Server. Nothing here is graded automatically: run the self-check check.sql on your machine and, when it prints ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED, press Mark as solved.

How to run it (Windows or macOS)

Press Tải .zip (download) above the code and unzip it. The folder has three files: setup.sql (re-creates a scratch database DBI202_CL with the sample tables), solution.sql (YOUR answer — edit only this one) and check.sql (4 checks; prints PASS/FAIL for each and ends with ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED). Always run them in this order: setup → solution → check.

  • Windows + SSMS (the course setup, lesson 0.3): open setup.sql → F5; open solution.sql → F5; open check.sql → F5, then read the Messages tab. Or in a terminal inside the folder (sqlcmd ships with SQL Server; otherwise winget install sqlcmd):
    sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (use -U sa -P "<password>" instead of -E for a SQL login).
  • macOS (SQL Server in Docker, as in lesson 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge
    then install the command-line client once with brew install sqlcmd and, inside the folder:
    sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -U sa -P "Dbi202#Lab" -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql
    (or open the three files in VS Code with the SQL Server (mssql) extension and run them in the same order).

Use CREATE OR ALTER for procedures, functions, triggers and views so that you can run solution.sql again and again. In the real PE you submit only the CREATE … statement, without GO or test commands.

Requirements

  • Simplest fix: no dynamic SQL at all — WHERE ten LIKE N'%' + @tuKhoa + N'%'.
  • If SQL must be dynamic: sp_executesql with a parameter (@p), never string concatenation.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Thủ tục tìm kiếm trong solution.sql ghép chữ người dùng gõ vào mã SQL. Thử xem: EXEC dbo.prTimSanPham N'x%'' UNION SELECT id, ten, 1 FROM dbo.SanPham --' hiện mọi sản phẩm với giá 1. Viết lại dbo.prTimSanPham @tuKhoa để từ khoá chỉ là giá trị: tìm bình thường vẫn chạy, payload không trả gì và không báo lỗi, còn '; DROP TABLE … không làm gì cả.

Chạy trên SQL SERVER CỦA BẠN, không chạy trong trình duyệt. Mã có lỗ hổng là SQL động T-SQL (EXEC một chuỗi ghép) trong procedure; tấn công và cách vá chỉ có nghĩa trên SQL Server thật. Trang này không tự chấm: chạy tệp tự kiểm check.sql trên máy bạn, khi nó in ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED thì bấm Tự đánh dấu đã giải.

Cách chạy (Windows hoặc macOS)

Bấm Tải .zip ở khung code rồi giải nén. Thư mục có ba tệp: setup.sql (tạo lại CSDL nháp DBI202_CL với các bảng mẫu), solution.sql (bài làm CỦA BẠN — chỉ sửa tệp này) và check.sql (4 kiểm; in PASS/FAIL từng kiểm và kết thúc bằng ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED). Luôn chạy đúng thứ tự: setup → solution → check.

  • Windows + SSMS (cài như bài 0.3): mở setup.sql → F5; mở solution.sql → F5; mở check.sql → F5, rồi đọc tab Messages. Hoặc mở terminal trong thư mục (sqlcmd đi kèm SQL Server; chưa có thì winget install sqlcmd):
    sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (đăng nhập SQL thì thay -E bằng -U sa -P "<mật khẩu>").
  • macOS (SQL Server trong Docker như bài 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge
    rồi cài trình dòng lệnh một lần bằng brew install sqlcmd và, trong thư mục bài:
    sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -U sa -P "Dbi202#Lab" -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql
    (hoặc mở ba tệp trong VS Code có extension SQL Server (mssql) và chạy đúng thứ tự đó).

Viết procedure, function, trigger, view bằng CREATE OR ALTER để chạy lại solution.sql bao nhiêu lần cũng được. Khi thi PE thật chỉ nộp lệnh CREATE …, không GO, không lệnh chạy thử.

Yêu cầu

  • Cách vá đơn giản nhất: bỏ hẳn SQL động — WHERE ten LIKE N'%' + @tuKhoa + N'%'.
  • Nếu bắt buộc SQL động: sp_executesql với tham số (@p), không bao giờ ghép chuỗi.

solutionCodeJson.name: solution.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
-- solution.sql — YOUR answer for: Exercise 1 — fix the SQL injection in a product search
-- Bài làm CỦA BẠN. Run order / thứ tự chạy: setup.sql → solution.sql → check.sql
USE DBI202_CL;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.prTimSanPham @tuKhoa NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    -- SAFE: @tuKhoa is only ever a VALUE, never part of the SQL text
    SELECT id, ten, gia
    FROM dbo.SanPham
    WHERE ten LIKE N'%' + @tuKhoa + N'%';
END

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Correct dynamic version, when the SQL text really must be built (e.g. a column chosen from a whitelist): EXEC sp_executesql N'SELECT id, ten, gia FROM dbo.SanPham WHERE ten LIKE @p', N'@p NVARCHAR(102)', @p = CONCAT(N'%', @tuKhoa, N'%');. In application code the same rule applies: prepared statements / parameters (Prisma, JDBC PreparedStatement), never template strings.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Bản động đúng, khi thật sự phải dựng chuỗi SQL (vd cột chọn từ danh sách trắng): EXEC sp_executesql N'SELECT id, ten, gia FROM dbo.SanPham WHERE ten LIKE @p', N'@p NVARCHAR(102)', @p = CONCAT(N'%', @tuKhoa, N'%');. Trong mã ứng dụng cùng luật: prepared statement / tham số (Prisma, JDBC PreparedStatement), không bao giờ chuỗi mẫu.

kiem: 1. A normal search for "kẻ" finds the two rulers/notebooks
2. The UNION payload returns nothing and raises no error
3. A DROP TABLE payload does nothing
4. A product name with an apostrophe can be searched

mistakesJson.loi: Switching to sp_executesql but still concatenating — the injection is identical.|||Chuyển sang sp_executesql nhưng vẫn ghép chuỗi — lỗ hổng y nguyên.

Blacklisting words such as UNION — attackers have endless variants; the apostrophe test also breaks real names.|||Chặn từ như UNION — kẻ tấn công có vô số biến thể; phép thử dấu nháy còn làm hỏng tên thật.

exercises.title: Exercise 2 — a least-privilege account for the revenue report
exercises.problemHtml:
A revenue report only needs to READ DonHang and KhachHang. NhanVien (salaries) must stay off-limits, and the report must not change anything. Create the role rBaoCao with exactly those permissions, and the user report_user (WITHOUT LOGIN, so the exercise works on any server) as its only member. check.sql impersonates the user with EXECUTE AS USER.

Runs on YOUR SQL Server, not in the browser. Users, roles, GRANT and EXECUTE AS are SQL Server security objects; the browser grader has a single all-powerful user. Nothing here is graded automatically: run the self-check check.sql on your machine and, when it prints ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED, press Mark as solved.

How to run it (Windows or macOS)

Press Tải .zip (download) above the code and unzip it. The folder has three files: setup.sql (re-creates a scratch database DBI202_CL with the sample tables), solution.sql (YOUR answer — edit only this one) and check.sql (4 checks; prints PASS/FAIL for each and ends with ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED). Always run them in this order: setup → solution → check.

  • Windows + SSMS (the course setup, lesson 0.3): open setup.sql → F5; open solution.sql → F5; open check.sql → F5, then read the Messages tab. Or in a terminal inside the folder (sqlcmd ships with SQL Server; otherwise winget install sqlcmd):
    sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (use -U sa -P "<password>" instead of -E for a SQL login).
  • macOS (SQL Server in Docker, as in lesson 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge
    then install the command-line client once with brew install sqlcmd and, inside the folder:
    sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -U sa -P "Dbi202#Lab" -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql
    (or open the three files in VS Code with the SQL Server (mssql) extension and run them in the same order).

Use CREATE OR ALTER for procedures, functions, triggers and views so that you can run solution.sql again and again. In the real PE you submit only the CREATE … statement, without GO or test commands.

Requirements

  • GRANT to the role, not to the user; add the user to the role with ALTER ROLE … ADD MEMBER.
  • Do NOT use db_datareader: it can read every table, salaries included.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Msg 229 "The SELECT permission was denied on the object 'NhanVien'" is the error the report would see. DENY is stronger than GRANT and wins over any role grant — keep it for explicit exceptions. PostgreSQL: CREATE ROLE … NOLOGIN; GRANT SELECT ON … TO …; GRANT role TO user.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Msg 229 "The SELECT permission was denied on the object 'NhanVien'" là lỗi báo cáo sẽ gặp. DENY mạnh hơn GRANT và thắng mọi quyền cấp qua role — giữ cho ngoại lệ tường minh. PostgreSQL: CREATE ROLE … NOLOGIN; GRANT SELECT ON … TO …; GRANT role TO user.

chayTaiMay.lyDo: Users, roles, GRANT and EXECUTE AS are SQL Server security objects; the browser grader has a single all-powerful user.|||User, role, GRANT và EXECUTE AS là đối tượng bảo mật của SQL Server; máy chấm trình duyệt chỉ có một người dùng toàn quyền.

exercises.title: Exercise 3 — multi-tenant Row-Level Security with SESSION_CONTEXT
exercises.problemHtml:
Ve(id, congTyId, tieuDe) holds support tickets of several companies. After login the app runs EXEC sp_set_session_context N'congTyId', @id. Make the database itself guarantee that a session sees only its company's tickets (and none when the context is not set) and cannot insert a ticket for another company — no WHERE clause needed in the app.

Create the inline function dbo.fnRlsCongTy(@congTyId) and the security policy dbo.spVeTheoCongTy with a FILTER and an AFTER INSERT BLOCK predicate.

Runs on YOUR SQL Server, not in the browser. Row-Level Security (security policies, inline predicate functions, SESSION_CONTEXT) is a SQL Server engine feature; nothing in the browser grader can enforce it. Nothing here is graded automatically: run the self-check check.sql on your machine and, when it prints ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED, press Mark as solved.

How to run it (Windows or macOS)

Press Tải .zip (download) above the code and unzip it. The folder has three files: setup.sql (re-creates a scratch database DBI202_CL with the sample tables), solution.sql (YOUR answer — edit only this one) and check.sql (4 checks; prints PASS/FAIL for each and ends with ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED). Always run them in this order: setup → solution → check.

  • Windows + SSMS (the course setup, lesson 0.3): open setup.sql → F5; open solution.sql → F5; open check.sql → F5, then read the Messages tab. Or in a terminal inside the folder (sqlcmd ships with SQL Server; otherwise winget install sqlcmd):
    sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (use -U sa -P "<password>" instead of -E for a SQL login).
  • macOS (SQL Server in Docker, as in lesson 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge
    then install the command-line client once with brew install sqlcmd and, inside the folder:
    sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -U sa -P "Dbi202#Lab" -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql
    (or open the three files in VS Code with the SQL Server (mssql) extension and run them in the same order).

Use CREATE OR ALTER for procedures, functions, triggers and views so that you can run solution.sql again and again. In the real PE you submit only the CREATE … statement, without GO or test commands.

Requirements

  • The predicate function: RETURNS TABLE WITH SCHEMABINDING AS RETURN SELECT 1 … WHERE @congTyId = CAST(SESSION_CONTEXT(N'congTyId') AS INT).
  • CREATE SECURITY POLICY … ADD FILTER PREDICATE … ON dbo.Ve, ADD BLOCK PREDICATE … ON dbo.Ve AFTER INSERT WITH (STATE = ON).

-- solution.sql — YOUR answer for: Exercise 3 — multi-tenant Row-Level Security with SESSION_CONTEXT
-- Bài làm CỦA BẠN. Run order / thứ tự chạy: setup.sql → solution.sql → check.sql
USE DBI202_CL;
GO
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fnRlsCongTy (@congTyId INT)
RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
RETURN SELECT 1 AS duoc
       WHERE @congTyId = CAST(SESSION_CONTEXT(N'congTyId') AS INT);   -- set by the app right after login
GO
CREATE SECURITY POLICY dbo.spVeTheoCongTy
    ADD FILTER PREDICATE dbo.fnRlsCongTy(congTyId) ON dbo.Ve,                 -- hides other companies' rows
    ADD BLOCK  PREDICATE dbo.fnRlsCongTy(congTyId) ON dbo.Ve AFTER INSERT     -- cannot write into another company
    WITH (STATE = ON);

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Exercise 4 — why two equal passwords must not get equal hashes — answer key

1. Stored as SHA-256(password), the two rows…Lưu dạng SHA-256(mật khẩu), hai dòng…
   Answer: c) hold identical hashes: cracking one cracks both
   Same input, same fast hash — and precomputed (rainbow) tables reverse common passwords instantly.VI: Cùng đầu vào, cùng hàm băm nhanh — và bảng tính sẵn (rainbow) đảo ngược mật khẩu phổ biến ngay lập tức.

2. bcrypt stores something like $2b$12$<22-char salt><hash>. The salt…bcrypt lưu dạng $2b$12$<muối 22 ký tự><hash>. Muối…
   Answer: c) is random per password, so equal passwords get different hashes
   The salt is not secret; it defeats precomputed tables and hides equal passwords.VI: Muối không bí mật; nó vô hiệu bảng tính sẵn và che việc hai mật khẩu giống nhau.

3. The "12" in $2b$12$ is…Số "12" trong $2b$12$ là…
   Answer: a) the cost factor: 2¹² rounds, deliberately slow to slow down guessing
   Fast hashes are good for files; for passwords you want slow (bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2).VI: Hàm băm nhanh tốt cho tệp; với mật khẩu cần chậm (bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2).

4. Where should the password hashing happen?Việc băm mật khẩu nên làm ở đâu?
   Answer: c) in the application, before the value reaches SQL
   The plain password should never travel to (or be logged by) the database. Encryption is reversible; a password needs a one-way hash.VI: Mật khẩu gốc không nên đi tới (hay bị ghi log bởi) CSDL. Mã hoá là đảo ngược được; mật khẩu cần băm một chiều.

exercises.title: Exercise 5 — partition a bookings table by month, then purge January fast
exercises.problemHtml:
DatPhongNguon(id, ngay, phong) holds bookings from January to April 2026. Build the partitioned table dbo.datphong(id, ngay, phong):

  1. partition function pfThang (DATE) — RANGE RIGHT with boundaries 2026-02-01, 2026-03-01, 2026-04-01 (4 partitions);
  2. partition scheme psThang (ALL TO ([PRIMARY]));
  3. dbo.datphong on psThang(ngay), primary key (ngay, id), filled from DatPhongNguon;
  4. then purge January with TRUNCATE TABLE … WITH (PARTITIONS (1)).

Runs on YOUR SQL Server, not in the browser. Partition functions, partition schemes and TRUNCATE … WITH (PARTITIONS) are SQL Server storage features; the browser grader cannot create or inspect them. Nothing here is graded automatically: run the self-check check.sql on your machine and, when it prints ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED, press Mark as solved.

How to run it (Windows or macOS)

Press Tải .zip (download) above the code and unzip it. The folder has three files: setup.sql (re-creates a scratch database DBI202_CL with the sample tables), solution.sql (YOUR answer — edit only this one) and check.sql (4 checks; prints PASS/FAIL for each and ends with ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED). Always run them in this order: setup → solution → check.

  • Windows + SSMS (the course setup, lesson 0.3): open setup.sql → F5; open solution.sql → F5; open check.sql → F5, then read the Messages tab. Or in a terminal inside the folder (sqlcmd ships with SQL Server; otherwise winget install sqlcmd):
    sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (use -U sa -P "<password>" instead of -E for a SQL login).
  • macOS (SQL Server in Docker, as in lesson 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge
    then install the command-line client once with brew install sqlcmd and, inside the folder:
    sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -U sa -P "Dbi202#Lab" -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql
    (or open the three files in VS Code with the SQL Server (mssql) extension and run them in the same order).

Use CREATE OR ALTER for procedures, functions, triggers and views so that you can run solution.sql again and again. In the real PE you submit only the CREATE … statement, without GO or test commands.

Requirements

  • RANGE RIGHT: each boundary date belongs to the partition on its RIGHT (2026-02-01 is in partition 2).
  • The partitioning column must be part of the clustered primary key.

DatPhongNguon(id, ngay, phong) chứa lượt đặt phòng từ tháng 1 tới tháng 4/2026. Dựng bảng phân vùng dbo.datphong(id, ngay, phong):

  1. partition function pfThang (DATE) — RANGE RIGHT với các mốc 2026-02-01, 2026-03-01, 2026-04-01 (4 phân vùng);
  2. partition scheme psThang (ALL TO ([PRIMARY]));

  4. rồi xoá tháng 1 bằng TRUNCATE TABLE … WITH (PARTITIONS (1)).

Chạy trên SQL SERVER CỦA BẠN, không chạy trong trình duyệt. Cách chạy (Windows hoặc macOS)

Bấm Tải .zip ở khung code rồi giải nén. Thư mục có ba tệp: setup.sql (tạo lại CSDL nháp DBI202_CL với các bảng mẫu), solution.sql (bài làm CỦA BẠN — chỉ sửa tệp này) và check.sql (4 kiểm; in PASS/FAIL từng kiểm và kết thúc bằng ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED). Luôn chạy đúng thứ tự: setup → solution → check.

  • macOS (SQL Server trong Docker như bài 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge
    rồi cài trình dòng lệnh một lần bằng brew install sqlcmd và, trong thư mục bài:

    (hoặc mở ba tệp trong VS Code có extension SQL Server (mssql) và chạy đúng thứ tự đó).

USE DBI202_CL;
GO
CREATE PARTITION FUNCTION pfThang (DATE)
    AS RANGE RIGHT FOR VALUES ('2026-02-01', '2026-03-01', '2026-04-01');   -- 4 partitions: <Feb | Feb | Mar | >=Apr
CREATE PARTITION SCHEME psThang AS PARTITION pfThang ALL TO ([PRIMARY]);
GO
CREATE TABLE dbo.datphong (
    id    INT         NOT NULL,
    ngay  DATE        NOT NULL,
    phong VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_datphong PRIMARY KEY (ngay, id)        -- the partitioning column must be part of the clustered key
) ON psThang (ngay);
GO
INSERT INTO dbo.datphong (id, ngay, phong) SELECT id, ngay, phong FROM dbo.DatPhongNguon;
GO
TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.datphong WITH (PARTITIONS (1));       -- purge January: a metadata operation, not 1 log record per row
